title: 5 Questions for Emotional Clarity
excerpt: Five gentle questions to sit with when things feel emotionally unclear — clarity often comes through noticing, not forcing.

body.text: When things feel emotionally unclear, try gently sitting with these questions:

items: What am I feeling right now, without trying to fix it?
What part of this situation feels heavy or unclear?
What do I need more of in this moment — space, clarity, or support?
What am I trying to control that is not fully mine to control?
If I slowed down, what would become more visible?

body.text: There is no need to rush answers. Clarity often comes through noticing, not forcing.
